{{CMD_PREFIX}}.enable.title: Enable {{EXT_NAME}}
{{CMD_PREFIX}}.enable.description: Controls whether the {{EXT_NAME}} extension is active or completely disabled in the current workspace.
{{CMD_PREFIX}}.enable.markdownDescription: Controls whether the **{{EXT_NAME}}** extension is active. When disabled, all associated commands (like `{{CMD_PREFIX}}.helloWorld`) will be unregistered gracefully.
